summary: Offer idle memory candidates in fixos auto

delivery.outcome: Rank processes by RSS + VmSwap with CPU idle time and age when fixos auto detects critical RAM or swap, list idle long-running user GUI apps as opt-in candidates reusing OrphanedWorkloadCleaner PID+create_time identity checks, add --close-idle-apps and interactive opt-in without killing by default, and print a memory before/after summary next to disk.
nonGoals: Automatically terminating processes without explicit --close-idle-apps or interactive confirmation, or ever targeting agent sessions or services.

architecture.decision: Add IdleMemoryCandidateCleaner subclassing OrphanedWorkloadCleaner in fixos/diagnostics/memory_candidates.py to rank RSS+VmSwap processes and safely gate allowlisted idle GUI apps with PID+create_time identity checks, emit critical swap alerts at 90% in quick_snapshot.py, and integrate opt-in candidate reporting and before/after memory summaries into fixos auto.
interfaceChanges: Add optional --close-idle-apps/--no-close-idle-apps flag and additive memory telemetry fields to fixos auto
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching memory_candidates.py, quick_snapshot.py, fix_cmd.py, and test_auto_memory_candidates.py.

validation.evidence: Processes rank by RSS+VmSwap with idle time and age, idle long-running GUI apps become opt-in candidates, and agent sessions/services remain protected.
fixos auto never kills by default, supports --close-idle-apps and interactive confirmation bound to PID+create_time, and prints memory before/after next to disk summary.

commands: python3 -m ruff check fixos/diagnostics/memory_candidates.py fixos/diagnostics/quick_snapshot.py fixos/cli/fix_cmd.py tests/unit/test_auto_memory_candidates.py
validation.evidence: Linter and full unit test suite pass without regressions.
Governance checks pass with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
